# Azure Storage — Blobs, Files & Data Lake

💳 Paid Azure subscription required — Curated by Skill Harbor — Microsoft's reference for the five Azure Storage services: Blob Storage (objects, backups, static content), File Shares (SMB lift-and-shift), Queue Storage (async task queues), Table Storage (NoSQL key-value) and Data Lake (big-data analytics), covering when to use each, the hot/cool/cold/archive access tiers, lifecycle management policies and redundancy options from LRS to GZRS, with MCP tools, CLI commands and SDK references for Python, TypeScript, Java and Rust. By @microsoft, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: storage is cheap but metered — archive tier needs rehydration before reads; this skill answers storage questions and drives commands, it doesn't cover SQL databases or Cosmos DB. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
